title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien
description: With his secret identity now revealed to the world, Ben Tennyson continues to fight evil as a superhero with the help of the newly acquired Ultimatrix.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 1x1
episodes_data.description: Ben's secret is out. As Ben deals with his newfound fame, a new threat emerges as a thief steals parts of a new advanced spaceship from NASA.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 1x2
episodes_data.description: Ben is supposed to attend a tournament to support his girlfriend, but the Forever Knights are trying to break into a museum. Ben tries to use the Ultimatrix to handle all his obligations.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 1x3
episodes_data.description: After Jimmy Jones reveals Ben's identity, some of his enemies (such as Zombozo, Rojo, Charmcaster, Vulkanus, and Sevenseven) team up to try to attack his family. Now Ben and his friends have to protect them no matter what.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 1x4
episodes_data.description: Ben gets an offer to star in his own video game, but the designer's real motives are part of a plan to destroy Ben.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 1x5
episodes_data.description: The team encounters another alien who escaped from Aggregor and, through him, learns more about Aggregor's goals.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 1x6
episodes_data.description: P'Andor, escaped from Aggregor, now wants help to escape his encapsulating suit, but Kevin's the first to perceive that that's a fatally bad idea.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 1x7
episodes_data.description: Then team encounters another of Aggregor's escaped prisoners, Andreas, whom Argit is using as part of a scheme against the Forever Knights.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 1x8
episodes_data.description: Ra'ad, the last of Aggregor's escaped prisoners, attacks Ben and informs the team of the true fate of his comrades. He finds a safe hiding place but one that endangers Ben in the process.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 1x9
episodes_data.description: Ben meets his hero, Captain Nemesis, who's become jealous of all the attention Ben attracts.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 1x10
episodes_data.description: Aggregor has all five aliens. The Plumbers manage to disable Aggregor's ship, forcing Aggregor to find a new way to absorb their powers. The team makes a last ditch effort to save the alien prisoners.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 1x11
episodes_data.description: Aggregor has absorbed all the powers of his captured aliens. Now he's after the Map of Infinity.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 1x12
episodes_data.description: Cash and JT convince the team to allow them to take credit for the team's actions so they can earn money for Cash's mother's operation.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 1x13
episodes_data.description: Aggregor is after the next piece of the map on a watery planet.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 1x14
episodes_data.description: Aggregor escapes to a magical dimension. Gwen asks for Charmcaster's help to pursue him. The team learns about Charmcaster's past and why she's willing to help them now.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 1x15
episodes_data.description: With the fourth piece of the Map of Infinity almost in Aggregor's clutches, the gang chase him through the artificial planetoid known as Perplexahedron.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 1x16
episodes_data.description: As the team makes its final attempt to stop Aggregor, they find an unexpected ally, and one person will make a fateful decision with lasting repercussions.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 1x17
episodes_data.description: Kevin's out for payback on anyone who has ever crossed him. His next stop is a prison in the Null Void. Ben and Gwen try to stop him, where Ben comes to a grim decision.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 1x18
episodes_data.description: Argit asks Ben and Gwen for protection from Kevin, so they take him to the nearest Plumbers Academy, but that won't stop Kevin.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 1x19
episodes_data.description: Kevin starts going after Plumbers kids to gain more power. Ben and Gwen continue to argue about how to handle the situation. Gwen tries to find someone who will help her cure Kevin.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 1x20
episodes_data.description: Final confrontation with Kevin. While Gwen makes a last ditch effort to save Kevin, Ben fights an all out battle with Kevin.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 2x1
episodes_data.description: A mysterious alien girl named Eunice has no memory and is being hunted by Sunder. While evading Sunder, Ben soon discovers that Eunice has nature-based abilities.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 2x2
episodes_data.description: Ben, Julie and the rest of the heroic crew embark on a dangerous journey that could cost them all their lives in an effort to achieve the safe return of Ship and his former owner Baz-L.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 2x3
episodes_data.description: The King of Zarkovia asks the team for help with a civil war. The team agrees to help when they find out Dr. Viktor may be involved.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 2x4
episodes_data.description: Jimmy Jones is looking for the biggest new story he and Ben can tackle, but thats when he stumbles upon a strange pink tentacled creature which crashed from the sky into a near by cave.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 2x5
episodes_data.description: Gwen is excited by the prospect of her cousin Sunny paying the team a visit while dealing with the Robots of Dimension 12. But her excitement quickly turns into trepidation when it is uncovered that her cousin is not all that she appears and has some particularly sinister intentions.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 2x6
episodes_data.description: Victor Validus resurfaces and attacks Ben at night. Elena Validus and the nanochips return.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 2x7
episodes_data.description: The Forever Knights unleash an evil force mistaken for an ancient weapon.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 2x8
episodes_data.description: Ben, Gwen, and Kevin are summoned to a Plumbers' Academy to go under training that is supervised by Magister Hulka.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 2x9
episodes_data.description: Gwen has always been a multi-tasker, trying to juggle school, hobbies, friends and her work as a hero, waking up early and going to sleep late. But Gwen's already packed day is about to get worse when Dr. Animo attacks with an army of giant frogs and Gwen is forced to make a hard choice.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 2x10
episodes_data.description: Following a visit from Paradox after a fight with Eon, Ben 10,000 arrives 20 years from the future to seek the aid of his past counterpart in tracking down Eon.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 2x11
episodes_data.description: Grandpa Max tells the team about his first UFO encounter, which led him to meet Verdona.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 2x12
episodes_data.description: After a base is attacked, Max is infuriated when they learn it was a secret alien prison facility. While Max argues with the officer in charge, the team tries to locate an escaped prisoner.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 2x13
episodes_data.description: Old George, the original Forever Knight, reclaims his position, and orders the Knights to remove all aliens on Earth.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 2x14
episodes_data.description: Simian asks the team for help when a DNAlien takes over his home world.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 2x15
episodes_data.description: Ben faces Tecadon killer robots that have been programmed to kill him. Each robot is more powerful than the last one. Ben's only chance to survive is for Gwen to find out who commissioned the robots.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 2x16
episodes_data.description: Julie gets Ben to visit a charity organization who wants to improve the world with alien technology. Ben soon discovers the charity's benefactor is an old enemy.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 2x17
episodes_data.description: Ben finds out there's a new show called 'Ben 10: Live." He finds an old enemy running the show and cashing in on his fame.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 2x18
episodes_data.description: Julie suddenly leaves a tennis tournament and spends all her time with Ben.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 2x19
episodes_data.description: Ben's Ultimate transformations have developed their own personalities. Now they want their freedom from Ben.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 2x20
episodes_data.description: Colonel Rozum asks the team to investigate an island of garbage where people have been disappearing.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 2x21
episodes_data.description: Ma Vreedle goes to Earth to expand her family by creating clones and using all the water on Earth.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 2x22
episodes_data.description: The Flame Keepers realize their mistake too late. Vilgax wants the power of Daigon. The Forever Knights are out to destroy Daigon. Ben and the team try to sort things out.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 2x23
episodes_data.description: Azmuth reveals the origin of the sword and how he first encountered Old George. Ben comes to a decision on how to handle the Daigon.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 2x24
episodes_data.description: A Techadon weapon master comes to Earth and wants the Ultimatrix.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 2x25
episodes_data.description: Gwen and co revisit Legerdomain in hopes of rescuing Charmcaster.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 2x26
episodes_data.description: After Darkstar opens the Door to Anywhere, Charmcaster comes through, and the two team up to give Ben, Gwen, and Kevin the fight of a lifetime.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 2x27
episodes_data.description: Movie starlet Jennifer Nocturne is recaptured by the evil Captain Nemesis!

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 2x28
episodes_data.description: Dr. Animo is unexpectedly paroled from prison and starts up a company selling eggs, which in fact contain mutant dinosaurs which he wishes to distribute around the world.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 2x29
episodes_data.description: Albedo attempts to get the ultimatrix by invading Ben's mind.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 2x30
episodes_data.description: The final battle between the Forever Knights and Dagon's Esoterica is in full swing, with Ben caught in the middle!

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 2x31
episodes_data.description: Dagon is getting closer and closer to entering our dimension thanks to an old foe.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien 2x32
episodes_data.description: Vilgax re-emerges in his most powerful form ever! Can Ben stop him and save the universe?
